name: Acia
source:
Acia is one of the teachers in Xen Institute. According to Yuon, she was one of the school's founders along with Essi's mother. Due to this, Yuon assigned Essi to class 2A--- the class that Acia teaches.

She can usually be found in the classroom after class.

[from [url=http://www.zeiva.net/otome/x_note_cast_acia.html]official site[/url]]
